features.title: Cast from another Jellyfin app
features.pitch: Cast from a Jellyfin app on your phone or browser to an open JellyRock, then pause, seek and skip from there.

features.title: Cast while JellyRock is closed
features.pitch: Cast from a Jellyfin app to your Roku while JellyRock is closed, when your server is on the same network as the Roku.

features.title: Fast cleanup after you press Home
features.pitch: Press Home on your Roku mid-playback and your server ends the session within a minute instead of 5 to 10 minutes.

features.title: SyncPlay (watch together)
features.pitch: Watch together in a Jellyfin SyncPlay group, and the group stops waiting on your Roku once you close JellyRock.
